entities.name: Ajit Singh Bhogal

entities.summary: Ajit Singh Bhogal is a Ugandan field hockey player. He competed in the men's tournament at the 1972 Summer Olympics. He is the brother of Ugandan hockey international player Kuldip Singh Bhogal.
